blurb: Ashton Hills Golf Club offers an 18-hole golf course designed by Desmond Muirhead with a 6906-yard layout featuring unique challenges for all skill levels. The club includes a large practice range, putting green, and an on-site restaurant called The Village Grille serving light fare and full-course meals. The venue also hosts weekly games and is available for events and catering.
